word: # This book's own vocabulary: names, places and props only this story needs.
# Temporary by design — it lives and dies with the book, so retiring the book
# takes its words with it and no other book's brief ever sees them.
# The reader's own standing vocabulary is lists/personal.tsv, which is theirs.

gloss: Mr. Ban — Along's imaginary sick friend
Cheng — a name; the character also means "honest, sincere"
